summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to assess how Executive departments can improve coordination, information sharing, and awareness programs related to mental health crisis prevention and awareness, and then requires departments to implement the resulting recommendations.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on improving mental health crisis prevention and awareness through assessments and coordination among Executive departments. Mental health services are a component of healthcare, and this bill aims to improve access and identification of individuals needing such services, thus expanding a specific aspect of public healthcare provision.
